intuition: At checkout, compute one trip duration and add it to totals keyed by the route.

brute_force.approach: Store every completed trip and scan route-matching trips to calculate each average.
brute_force.time: checkIn O(1), checkOut O(1), getAverageTime O(n)

optimal.approach: Map active riders to check-in details and maintain a duration sum and trip count per station pair.
optimal.time: checkIn O(1), checkOut O(1), getAverageTime O(1)

edge_cases: A route average uses all completed trips in both directions separately.
Repeated trips on one route update its running total and count.
